At Unique Building Contractors, we ensure this journey is as seamless as the final result. We believe that a custom home should reflect the personality of its owner. That's why we emphasize a collaborative approach, keeping you informed and involved at every critical junction. Whether it's a modern minimalist estate or a classic coastal residence, we bring the same level of craftsmanship and passion to every square foot we build.

New Construction Across Tampa Bay

Unique Building Contractors provides coordinated new-home construction across Tampa Bay, from early planning and permitting through inspections and final finishes.

Unique Building Contractors is a Florida Certified Building Contractor (CBC1268844) serving St. Pete Beach, Clearwater Beach, Belleair, South Tampa, Davis Islands, Tampa, Carrollwood, Clearwater, St. Petersburg, Dunedin, Palm Harbor, Brandon, Riverview, Wesley Chapel, Lutz, Land O' Lakes, New Port Richey, Sarasota and surrounding Tampa Bay communities.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is included in new home construction?

The scope can include site planning, foundation, framing, building systems, interior and exterior finishes, inspections, and overall construction coordination.

Who coordinates permits and inspections for new construction?

New construction requires a full building permit through the applicable local authority, covering foundation, framing, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, and final inspections. Unique Building Contractors manages all permit applications and schedules every required inspection milestone as the licensed contractor of record (CBC1268844).

Can you work with an architect or designer?

Yes. The construction team can coordinate with the project architect, engineers, and designers so approved plans and field work remain aligned throughout the build.

What areas in Tampa Bay do you serve for new construction?

Unique Building Contractors serves the full Tampa Bay region for new construction, including Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, and Sarasota counties. We manage permitting directly with the applicable local authority for each project location.
